metadata.baseline_provenance_note: Frozen pre-prototype source and existing binary. The pre-existing vendor-header CRLF/LF difference from the Git checkout is preserved and separately disclosed; hashes identify the exact measured bytes.

variant_descriptions.baseline: Current integrated e911 baseline public parse; existing depth limit may trigger a second event parse.
variant_descriptions.iterative_dom: Iterative DOM/default public parse: iterative DOM for default in-memory str/bytes, existing Python event mapping for file/callback/options.
variant_descriptions.native_events: Private direct native-event dictionary mapper, forced via the recorded wrapper entry point.
variant_descriptions.xmltodict: Unmodified xmltodict 1.0.4 public parse, Expat reference.

method.input_generation: Separate generator process, all fixtures generated before all measured workers.
method.ordering: Balanced rotating variant order, offset by workload index and repetition.
method.standard_rss: First parse in each fresh sample worker; sampled before fingerprint and before warmed timing batches.
method.large_timing: One parse per fresh process; output destruction and fixture loading excluded; file reading included.
method.rss: Linux current RSS and ru_maxrss, post-import/post-input baseline, total peak, peak minus baseline high-water mark, and retained current RSS. Input and output remain alive at sample.
method.incremental_peak_caveat: Incremental peak subtracts baseline high-water RSS, not current baseline RSS; a previous input-loading peak can make incremental growth look small.
method.callbacks: Same item_depth=2 callback tracks count/order/identifier sums. Discard retains no items; retain stores every item until RSS sample. File streams read through the normal wrapper.
method.correctness: Complete typed iterative fingerprints for direct outputs. Separate unmeasured callback integrity workers hash every path and item. Measured callbacks validate full count and identifier checksums.
method.memory_guard: Skip estimated peak over 40% MemAvailable or 80% RLIMIT_AS; stop on worker failure, no automatic OOM retry.

metadata.publication_provenance_note: Published source revision supplied after the frozen run began; the exact on-disk runtime source/binary hashes are authoritative. The disclosed vendored-header CRLF/LF normalization difference from Git is preserved.
metadata.experiment_stage: Final architecture benchmark, build5: three-trial balanced four-way run

derived_memory_metrics.incremental_peak_rss_bytes: Original recorded metric: max(0, peak_rss_bytes - baseline_peak_rss_bytes)
derived_memory_metrics.summary: Each summary is the median of per-sample differences, not a difference of independently calculated medians.
derived_memory_metrics.interpretation: Arithmetic whole-process RSS comparisons, not isolated allocation attribution. Input-loading transients affect the prior high-water baseline; Linux RSS accounting/sampling can differ slightly.
